about_the_game:
MYCELIUM

There is no life after death but there's always more work to do. Having signed a contract in exchange for a successful life, now that it has ended, you are obliged to perform tasks for a company called Mycelium.

YOU ARRIVE

Each cycle you arrive at a dark and motionless forest where silence is your best friend. The forest is never the same, so you'll have to find your bearings over and over again. Don't get lost - or you might never come back.

YOU GATHER

Look for mycelium as that's what you need to complete the contract and free your soul. Buy equipment the company provides and find valuables to get more time in the future cycles. The more time you get, the more mysteries you can solve.

YOU EXTRACT

Use the mycelium you've got to extract from the cycle. But hurry up - you can't stay in the forest forever. The longer you stay, the more dangerous it becomes, as there is always someone or something that wants your mycelium more than you do.

WORK TOGETHER

They are not your friends, but other contractors may help you to speed things up. Take care of each other but always remember to take care of yourself first.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features notes and voice lines with adult language. Some events in the game as a result of procedural generation may be perceived as screamers and frighten players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 2080 RTX or AMD Radeon RX 5800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 3080 RTX or AMD Radeon RX 6800XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: You arrive. You gather. You extract. Join an endless cycle of hunting for Mycelium in a forest that is never the same. Work alone or with other contractors, solve the mysteries and avoid dangers. But don't worry - you can't die twice. There are things worse than that.
